passages.provision_quote: A covered provider shall include a latent disclosure in AI-generated image, video, or audio content, or content that is any combination thereof, created by the covered provider’s GenAI system that meets all of the following criteria:
passages.note: Becker authored a disclosure and provenance mandate on large GenAI providers, enforced by a $5,000 civil penalty for violating the disclosure duties.

rows.reasoning: Becker authored SB 942 (2023-2024), which requires covered providers to offer an AI detection tool and to include manifest and latent disclosures in AI-generated content, with a civil penalty for violating those duties. The annex rules that a disclosure or labelling duty (watermarks, provenance, telling users they are dealing with AI) fits no Season 2 rung, and the penalty attaches to non-disclosure, not to "when their systems cause harm", so it does not match "Hold AI developers legally responsible when their systems cause harm". The mandate excludes "Suggest AI safety guidelines but let companies choose whether to follow them" and names no safety testing before use in high-stakes areas and no government approval before deployment, so the record shows only the pro-oversight side.
